summary: Volkswagen Auto Lease/Loan Underwritten Funding, LLC and Volkswagen Auto Lease Trust 2026-B filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus covering a $991,830,000 auto-lease asset-backed securitization. Four senior classes price at par to 99.85% of principal, with coupons from 4.176% fixed to SOFR plus 0.35%, maturities from September 2027 through May 2031. Credit enhancement includes a reserve account at 0.25% of initial securitization value and $174,350,764.59 initial overcollateralization. Joint bookrunners are Mizuho, RBC, US Bancorp and Wells Fargo. This is a routine term ABS takedown, not a corporate special situation; watch monthly 20th payment dates and retained-class overhang.
